raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The v2 collector emits txn_ts in UTC while legacy emits America/Chicago local time, and silver_transactions does not normalize this. The 36 'extra' 2026-01-19 rows are v2 transactions whose UTC timestamps fall between 00:00 and 06:00, which is 18:00-00:00 Chicago time on 2026-01-18, so they are mis-dated and their hours look wrong. Converting v2 timestamps from UTC to America/Chicago before deriving txn_date fixes the date and time-of-day for those rows.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' AS TIMESTAMP) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, status FROM raw_transactions) s WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
